Gulf Medical Company
(GMC)
does not primarily sell or distribute consumer or patient-facing wearable medical devices
; instead, it focuses on advanced hospital equipment, surgical technologies, imaging systems, and clinical solutions. It was founded in
1983
, is headquartered in
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
, and operates as a major medical device distributor and healthcare solutions provider across Saudi Arabia and the GCC region
Gulf Medical Company
Company Profile
Founding Year:
1983
Headquarters:
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Core Business:
Sales, marketing, and distribution of high-end medical technology, hospital infrastructure, and clinical systems.
Gulf Medical Company
What the Company Does
Supplies advanced hospital hardware including imaging, oncology solutions, and pharmacy automation.
Equips specialized operating rooms, intensive care units (ICUs), and surgical suites.
Focuses on institutional medical tech (such as robotic surgery and radiosurgery systems) rather than personal, portable, or wearable health gadgets.

Gulf Medical Company
provides high-end hospital solutions, digital health infrastructure, and clinical medical devices across Saudi Arabia and the GCC
. While regional distributors like Gulf Drug offer consumer and clinical systems like the IntelliGO CGM, major corporate medical suppliers focus primarily on institutional ICU, cardiac, and clinical remote monitoring setups rather than direct-to-consumer smartwatches or sleep trackers.
